members.originalTitle: Threaded WhatsApp support with window-aware replies (WA-10)
members.reason: Declared co-primary REQ, bundled onto one shared branch/PR/release at Phase 1 planning time.
members.scopeSummary:
A customer has one ongoing support conversation: inbound WhatsApp messages append to their open ticket (a resolved ticket reopens within 72 hours), staff replies go out free-form inside the 24-hour window and as the `support_reply` template outside it, and "Chat with staff" raises an urgent ticket with a 15-minute SLA that sorts first. Details, acceptance criteria and risks: `compliance/plans/REQ-118/implementation-plan.md`.

This ticket is a skeleton written at Stage 1; Stage 3 completes it.
